name: Akatsuki no Lily Philia
source:
Shiroko Uehara lives independently though she is just a student.
Her daily life is uneventful but peaceful, together with her friend Saki Sonoda.

But suddenly, sequential violence incidents start happening in her town.
Since she is living alone, it makes her worry about incoming threat.

On one day of such disquieting days, a girl rushes into Shiroko's house.

Her name is Chitose. She says that she has been running around 
because she was assaulted by somebody.

Since that day Shiroko lives together with Chitose, who tries to have H with Shiroko.

A man whose face is hidden by a hoodie keeps his eyes on them...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE213161.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
上原诗郎子虽然只是一名学生，但她独立生活。
她和朋友园田咲的日常生活平静而平静。

但突然间，她所在的城镇开始发生连续的暴力事件。
由于她独自生活，这让她担心即将到来的威胁。

在这样令人不安的日子里的某一天，一名女孩冲进了白子的家。

她的名字叫千岁。她说她一直在四处奔波 
因为她被人侵犯了。

从那天起，白子和千岁住在一起，千岁试图和白子拥有H。

一个用连帽衫遮住脸的男人一直盯着他们……
